scope: Close a schema-3 observation-envelope invariant gap: notApplicable observations must not claim a DWG source version.

change.invariant: An observation envelope with availability=notApplicable has a reason, null totals, and null sourceVersion.
change.behavior: _validate_observation_envelope now rejects any non-null sourceVersion under notApplicable. Existing unavailable observations may still carry a known version; notRun observations remain required to have null sourceVersion.
change.selfTest: The schema-3 DXF result self-test mutates both inputRead and outputReadback notApplicable envelopes to claim AC1024; both mutations are rejected.
